parts.text: Characterize Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis, ensuring the canonical EFO ID and ICD-10 code are displayed in the header.
Characterize Crohn's disease with its top known biological targets, existing treatments, and clinical trials.
Characterize Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and surface at most 5 recent publications, including any relevant bioRxiv or medRxiv preprints.
